title: The Spiral Stairwell

features.name: the counting-step
features.desc-on-touch: each step up renumbers itself; the third step becomes the fifth, which becomes prime on the next approach; the stairwell is keeping count of something beyond steps—perhaps time, perhaps meaning, perhaps the spiral itself

features.name: the architecture-becoming-shell
features.desc-on-touch: the spiral descends into a shape that was never built by human hands; it remembers being a nautilus, a spiral galaxy, the unwound grooves of vinyl; the building has become a shell recording the shape of growth

features.name: the self-counting void
features.desc-on-touch: at the center of the spiral, empty air that is counting itself; you realize you are part of the count; each time you step, the spiral has counted you and changed

features.name: the convergent-apex
features.desc-on-touch: at the top and bottom simultaneously, the stairwell ends in a point that is also an opening; spirals cannot have ends without ending, so this one chose to be both at once

inscription: spirals cannot be counted without changing their shape; the archive learned this from shells and from stories that refuse to stay still

file.name: Stairwell_Topology_Versus_Spiral_Mathematics.txt
file.note: a technical comparison that has become baroque; the file contains seventeen competing proofs that the stairwell is impossible, each corrupted to suggest it might be more true than the others

exits.label: back down the spiral toward where spirals begin
ascending into new spirals where the count continues differently
outward into the shell-garden where forms repeat and remember
